P1.text: Every stack contains at least one yellow object.

P2.text: Every large square has a small object resting directly on top of it (vacuously true if there are no large squares).

P3.text: No large object rests directly on a small object.

P4.text: Every circle is in a stack to the left of every triangle (vacuously true if there are no circles or no triangles).

P5.text: There is at least one large yellow object.

P6.text: There are more red objects than blue objects.

P7.text: The total number of objects is odd.

P8.text: Every triangle rests directly on a blue object (vacuously true if there are no triangles).
